items.title: YPF Eyes Year-End LNG Green Light as Vaca Muerta Shale Expansion Advances
items.summary: Argentina’s national oil company YPF is advancing natural gas midstream infrastructure and is eyeing a potential final investment decision (FID) on a flagship LNG project by the end of the year, executives said in an earnings call.

items.title: Battery Storage Growing at Rapid Clip, Helping to Stabilize California Natural Gas Prices
items.summary: Utility-scale battery storage in the United States grew by 70% annually over the past three years and is on track to double from current levels by the end of 2028, according to federal researchers.

items.title: Nuclear Outages, Searing Heat Deepen Europe's Call on US LNG
items.summary: Two tropical systems are easing cooling demand across Japan and eastern China through the middle of the month as US export volumes climb and Europe's refill window narrows.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Give Back Gains Even as Heat Builds
items.summary: Natural gas futures pulled back early Tuesday despite another hotter shift in weather forecasts, with analysts pointing to short covering behind Monday’s sharp advance while near-term power and LNG demand showed signs of easing.

items.title: Plentiful Supply Checks Summer’s Sizzle as Natural Gas Futures Sputter
items.summary: Natural gas futures stepped back on Tuesday amid plump supply readings and profit-taking following a rare late 2026 summer rally at the start of the week.

items.title: Faster Builds Push Venture Global Toward Shorter LNG Contracts
items.summary: Venture Global LNG is continuing to shift its model away from a reliance on 20-year contracts that financed the first two waves of US LNG export capacity to shorter deals as hastened construction timelines unlock more flexible opportunities.
